explain.say: Drop an egg onto a hard floor: splat! Drop it onto a soft pillow: it survives. Same egg, same speed. What changed? The time it took to stop. Car designers use exactly this trick to save lives. Let us see how.

explain.say: Look at the first reason. A moving person has momentum, which means mass times velocity. In a crash, that momentum must drop to zero, whatever happens. The only question is how fast. Does the momentum have to go?

faq.a: A crumple zone is a part of a car, usually the front and back, designed to crush slowly in a crash so the car stops more gradually.

faq.q: Why does a longer stopping time help?
faq.a: The same change in momentum spread over more time needs a smaller force, so less force acts on the people inside.
asks: How does stopping time affect force?

faq.q: What is the formula linking force and momentum?
faq.a: Force equals change in momentum divided by the time taken for the change.
asks: F = change in momentum over time

faq.a: An airbag inflates in a fraction of a second, then lets you sink in slowly, increasing the time to stop your head and chest.

faq.q: Why do cricketers pull their hands back when catching?
faq.a: Moving the hands back makes the ball take longer to stop, so the force on the hands is smaller and it stings less.
asks: How to catch a ball without it hurting

facts: Force = change in momentum ÷ time taken.
Crumple zones, airbags and seatbelts all reduce the force on passengers by increasing the stopping time.

quiz.why: The same momentum change over a longer time needs a smaller force.

wrong.0: Extra mass would give more momentum, not less force.
wrong.2: An instant stop would give a huge force.

quiz.say: A 1000 kg car at 20 m/s stops in 0.1 s. What average force acts?
quiz.show: A 1000 kg car at 20 m/s stops in 0.1 s. What average force acts?
quiz.why: Change in momentum = 1000 × 20 = 20 000 kg m/s, and 20 000 ÷ 0.1 = 200 000 newtons.

wrong.0: That forgets to divide by 0.1 seconds.
wrong.1: Change in momentum is 20 000 kg m/s; dividing by 0.1 s gives 200 000 N.
